repackFeatures: Based on Switch release with Update v1.0.1 installed over: 9.8 GB; many thanks to two secret guys for helping me out with building this repack
Portable Yuzu Switch emulator included: Mainline v542 (Feb 17, 2021)
100% Lossless, but NOT MD5 Perfect: encryption on game files was removed for better repack size
Significantly smaller archive size (compressed from 9.8 to 5.4 GB)
Installation takes 6-10 minutes (depending on your system)
After-install integrity check so you could make sure that everything installed properly
HDD space after installation: 9.9 GB (19.1 GB during installation)
Language can be changed in Yuzu’s game settings (RMB on a game -> Properties -> System -> Language)

Please be patient while playing this game – it lags a lot when building shaders for the 1st time. But the more you play – the smoother the process is
